reviews.comment:
Me atendieron muy mal por teléfono!! llame para consultar por el servicio del auto, y literal el tipo que me atendió no hablaba... hacia sonidos tipo mmm, se,   cuando le digo lo que necesito, me dice aca no es, te paso y me paso al interno que correspondia cuando en la opcion de entrada oprimi la opcion "Taller", me pasa y me atiende otro muchacho con voz de pocos amigos y me trata muy mal, el precio es este + esto y mas esto. gracias le digo y me corta. La verdad si tenia algun indicio de hacer el service ahi, ya no lo voy hacer, tendrian que ser un poco mas empaticos con el cliente me parece!!!!!

(Translated by Google)
I received terrible service on the phone! I called to inquire about car service, and the guy who answered literally didn't speak... he just made sounds like "mmm, yeah." When I told him what I needed, he said, "This isn't the right place, I'll transfer you," and then he transferred me to the correct extension. I had actually selected "Workshop" on the call screen, and another guy with a very unfriendly voice answered and treated me very rudely. "The price is this + this + this," he said. "Thank you," I said, and he hung up. Honestly, if I had any intention of getting the service done there, I'm definitely not going back. They should be a little more empathetic with their customers, in my opinion!
